scientific_question: Does a joint redesign of synthetic observation distributions improve real STU performance with the same model?
interpretation: multifactor development experiment; not a causal ablation or independent test

roles.excluded: hidden test; real points and labels as training examples; real normalization updates

targets.shape_rule: observed geometry with unchanged profile reliability rules; full physical extent is not a real visible-span estimate

generation.placement_rule: qualified source support over the full trajectory; strict grounding and no observed deep penetration
generation.opaque_surface: nearest geometric hit wins before return acceptance; failed return clears a blocked native slot
generation.intensity: float32(round(3500*I)/3500), new anomaly returns only; no clipping
generation.normal_context: retain all native slots except physical occlusion; no artificial neighborhood clearing
generation.selection: data-only; every evaluated candidate and rejection retained in the generation record
generation.pool_candidate_objective: bounded combination search in world order; keep 32 prefixes; lexicographically minimize missing required far cells, summed visibility interval violations, and visibility TV plus qualified joint TV; ties use earlier attempt tuples

pilot.calibration: Round 1 established feasible candidate combinations; round 2 replaces irrevocable greedy selection with the fixed width-32 combination search. Physical generation parameters remain unchanged.
pilot.decision: Core visibility intervals and all three far cells are covered on both sources in round 2. Freeze these rules; no third pilot. Formal pools must report actual world coverage and remaining discrepancies.
pilot.remaining_limits: Few-point 35-50 m and 20-99 point 20-35 m cells each have only one pilot world per side. One proxy per world does not cover real multi-instance observations. Validation background proximity and geometry reliability remain different from real observations.
pilot.random_stream_note: The legacy round-1 validation and round-2 training pilot bases coincide numerically on different source sequences. No pilot enters a formal pool; both formal seed ranges are disjoint from every pilot range and from each other.

seed_rule: base + 1000 * world_index; attempt and factor streams use SeedSequence coordinates

training.model: unchanged LitePT-S, 9 voxel channels, point anomaly head
training.loss: existing class-balanced BCE over all valid window points
training.precision: existing fp16 autocast; float32 logits and loss
training.overflow: log and do not replace; stop after 3 consecutive overflows
training.normal_loss_weight_note: about half empty windows implies nominal normal/anomaly coefficients near 75/25; keep the original loss
training.status: deferred_by_user; settings below are the previous proposal, not an executed or newly approved model design

monitor.temporal_selection: evenly spaced order indices, including first and last, from full-history frames; no score selection
monitor.random_state: fixed check seed isolated and restored around monitoring
selection: within 0.1 percentage point of maximum: lower FPR95
lower real normal monitor fraction above 0.5
monitor.baseline_synthetic_monitor: epoch_07 on the same fixed v2 synthetic monitor

evaluation.startup: available prefix right aligned, no future or duplicated scans
evaluation.official: unchanged STU range, semantic and frame eligibility; global point aggregation
evaluation.score_storage: all actual window points, lossless float32 and original identities
evaluation.baseline_real: reuse epoch_07 complete real predictions; preserve original 3.475451% AP

resources.status: sample generation completed on E; any future model design requires a new training and evaluation budget
resources.storage_policy: all outputs remain on E; no C directory or symlink
resources.preserved: v1 epoch_07, initial.pt, full real predictions, normal201 predictions, all reports, profiles and manifests

execution_scope: User stopped this round after formal sample generation; model redesign precedes any training.

completion.formal_profile: stopped by user scope change after 12 of 32 training worlds; 0 of 8 validation worlds; no complete formal CSV profile
completion.preserved_partial_profile: runs/profiles/v2/train; completed worlds only; interrupted outputs removed
